market_question: SCOTUS accepts sports event contract case by July 31, 2026?
reasoning: Certiorari grants are rare (~1% of petitions), and a sports‑event‑contract case would first have to complete lower‑court litigation. Even if a petition is filed, the timeline is tight and no circuit split currently exists on this issue, making a grant by mid‑2026 unlikely.
evidence_points: SCOTUS grants cert in only ~1% of petitions; speculative cases rarely make the cut.
The CFTC’s event‑contracts rule is only now being challenged; trial and appellate proceedings will likely stretch beyond the July 31, 2026 deadline.
Absent a circuit split or a high‑stakes emergency motion, SCOTUS is very unlikely to intervene this quickly.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of SCOTUS certiorari statistics
Recent CFTC rulemaking and pending litigation over sports event contracts (e.g., Kalshi’s legal challenges)
